title: Harden ANTLR Python generation with post-generation lint normalization

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implementing source-level fix: make parser generation deterministic and scanner-compliant by running post-generation cleanup (ruff PIE790 fix + black) on generated Python parser files.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented source-level fix. Updated Makefile generate-python-parser target to post-process generated LuaParser with  and , and updated validation README manual generation instructions with the same steps. This makes regenerated parser output deterministic and codeql/format-compliant without manual hand edits.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Correction note: post-generation commands are python3 -m poetry run ruff check tactus/validation/generated/LuaParser.py --select PIE790 --fix and python3 -m poetry run black tactus/validation/generated/LuaParser.py.
